snippet.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP)
snippet.description:
No organization has perfect security. Security and privacy are tantamount to user trust in your app, but breaches can occur daily. Imagine if you could tap into the knowledge of hundreds of security researchers, all helping you identify vulnerabilities in your apps. You could find and fix vulnerabilities as they're introduced into production, helping reduce the risk of security incidents. You can also use this data to find root causes of vulnerabilities and make overarching improvements to your security program. These courses will teach you how to create a “Vulnerability Disclosure Program” (VDP). A VDP empowers your organization to work with external security researchers to find and fix vulnerabilities before they are exploited.

For more information visit: https://g.co/playacademy/vdp

snippet.title: Easy Android accessibility - Android Conference Talks
snippet.description:

In this talk, you'll learn how users of different accessibility services interact with your app, and find out about common accessibility issues and their solutions. Lyla Fujiwara and Shailen Tuli will dive into the basics of accessibility and demo Talk Back, Switch Access, Accessibility Scanner, Play launch reports and the Espresso ATF integration.
